g.text: SCR03 — Full binding catalog
Kotlin Compose screen definition · All bindings / FR-DEV-01 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Paged inventory then full-screen evidence/diff/import preview; expected hash/size/deadline remain visible. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent
rail at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR03.C01 · Inspect evidence
Fields: Source pin/locator, declared permissions, applicability and unknown reasons
Open immutable source evidence and effective binding/type revision
Failure: Missing evidence remains explicitly unknown; read never grants permission
SCR03.C02 · Edit local override
Fields: Field-level diff, types/dependencies, provenance and expected cat1 ETag
Create local override draft without rewriting imported evidence
Failure: Invalid schema/dependency blocks preview; discard returns immutable effective record
SCR03.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR03.C04 · Search inventory
Fields: Text/type/namespace/version/evidence filters and bounded limit
Search full inventory including unknown/unavailable/unassigned records
Failure: Empty results show query controls; malformed filter reports400 without hiding inventory
SCR03.C05 · Next catalog page
Fields: Opaque cursor, limit and byte budget
Fetch next bounded page in pinned inventory view
Failure: 410 clears cursor and offers restart at current generation
SCR03.C06 · Choose import document
Fields: Source manifest/hash, exact bytes, free-space estimate and deadline
Choose SAF file then private stage with expected hash/size and capacity preflight
Failure: Picker cancel releases transient grant; hash/schema/space failure leaves active catalog unchanged
SCR03.C07 · Preview override diff
Fields: Revision/ETag, dependencies, admin principal/window/method/path/digest, hash/size and TTL
Show exact override/import/admin command preview; no commit yet
Failure: Invalid preview shows precise field errors; owner prearming/commit requires SCR09
SCR03.C08 · Discard override or import
Fields: Draft/stage handle and active catalog identity
Discard unactivated stage or override draft and release its private files
Failure: Active imported history is retained; cleanup unknown is surfaced, never publication
SCR03.C09 · Activate validated import
Fields: Sealed stage hash, registry ID, expected generation, conflict/rebase preview
SCR09 approves exact validated registry publication; atomic CAS activates it
Failure: Failed validation/CAS/approval leaves old active registry; new review required
SCR03.C10 · Manage admin window
Fields: Disabled/ordinary10min/import-only TTL, admin principal and allowed operations
Enable scoped admin window or disable it via exact local SCR09 command
Failure: Expiry/revoke closes admin work; no MCP credential becomes admin; no hidden listener
SCR03.C11 · Reload catalog revision
Fields: Current ETag and conflict differences
Reload changed cat1 revision and recompute preview without applying draft
Failure: Unknown new schema prevents save until owner resolves fields
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR03.S0 · Inventory: selected binding/effective revision
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Full imported/override inventory visible including unknown applicability; no grant change.
Recovery: Search/filter, read evidence or stage a local draft.
SCR03.S1 · No matches: search remains available
Disabled: SCR03.C01, SCR03.C02, SCR03.C05, SCR03.C07, SCR03.C09, SCR03.C11
Effect: No binding selected; empty query result is not an empty source corpus.
Recovery: Broaden filters or choose a validated import; no empty-record edit.
SCR03.S2 · Schema unknown: evidence retained
Disabled: SCR03.C02, SCR03.C09
Effect: Record visible with reason; unproven codec/type graph cannot activate invocation.
Recovery: Inspect evidence or stage explicit supported metadata; do not invent wire layout.
SCR03.S3 · Device view stale: calls blocked
Disabled: SCR03.C09
Effect: Inventory reads continue; current availability display is stale, not absent.
Recovery: Refresh device view through SCR01; old metadata is never silently relabeled.
SCR03.S4 · Override/import/admin exact preview
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Show exact fields/dependencies/ETag, stage hash/size, estimate/deadline and admin window.
Recovery: Discard or request SCR09 approval for this exact command; preview itself never commits.
SCR03.S5 · Import invalid: active catalog unchanged
Disabled: SCR03.C02, SCR03.C07, SCR03.C09
Effect: Hash/schema/FK/capacity validation failed in quarantine; no trusted imported reads.
Recovery: Inspect specific error, discard stage, select a different expected artifact.
SCR03.S6 · No catalog: only safe staging available
Disabled: SCR03.C01, SCR03.C02, SCR03.C04, SCR03.C05, SCR03.C07, SCR03.C09, SCR03.C11
Effect: Admission closed; search/evidence/override actions have no active inventory.
Recovery: Choose import document and independently verify hash/size before stage.
SCR03.S7 · Validated sealed import: ready for review
Disabled: SCR03.C02
Effect: Stage bytes sealed and validation report pinned; old active catalog still serves.
Recovery: Activate exact import through SCR09 or discard before expiry.
SCR03.S8 · Admin window disabled or expired
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: No administration request is admitted; MCP/device invocation permissions unchanged.
Recovery: Local Manage admin window opens exact scope/lifetime review.
SCR03.S9 · Scoped admin window open: remaining lifetime visible
Disabled: none; owner/backend exact command checks remain
Effect: Only the approved admin principal/artifact/operation scope is reachable until the monotonic deadline; no MCP grant is created.
Recovery: Disable via exact local action or let expiry revoke active admin work; each mutation still needs its own exact approval.
